dataset: L&T Vehicle Loan Default (India), labels not used for training
split: learn on Aug-Sep 2018, test on Oct 2018 plus planted odd applications

left_out_on_purpose.State_ID, Current_pincode_ID, branch_id: Where someone lives. A rare location must not make an application 'odd'.
left_out_on_purpose.supplier_id, manufacturer_id, Employee_c: IDs with no order; they describe the dealer or staff, not the applicant.
left_out_on_purpose.Aadhar_flag, PAN_flag and other ID flags: Aadhaar is voluntary; choosing a different ID must not look suspicious.
left_out_on_purpose.age_years on its own: A very young or old applicant is rare but not suspicious. Age is used only to spot a credit history that starts before 18.
